result.title: SOTS: Signature-based Optimal Transport Selection
result.summary: Training data selection for machine learning models is a critical bottleneck in industrial applications where expert annotation is costly and time-consuming. Existing coreset selection methods for time series either ignore temporal structure entirely or cannot handle variable-length, irregularly sampled, multi-channel signals, the setting most common in industrial monitoring and testing. We introduce SOTS (Signature-based Optimal Transport Selection), an unsupervised coreset selection framework for irregular multivariate time series (IMTS) classification. Each sample is mapped to a truncated path signature, capturing the joint geometric structure of its channels, and the coreset is selected by greedily minimizing the Sliced Wasserstein distance between the empirical signature distributions of the candidate subset and the full dataset, a criterion for which we establish a convergence guarantee for random coresets. We validate SOTS on a real-world, highly imbalanced industrial I&C testing dataset, where SOTS-Greedy exceeds 95% of full-dataset accuracy using only 30% of the training data, outperforming standard coreset baselines at most budgets. This advantage generalizes to public UEA regular multivariate time series benchmarks specifically when class-discriminative information is purely geometric.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 SOTS，一种面向不规则多变量时间序列分类的无监督 coreset 选择框架：用截断路径签名刻画多通道联合几何结构，并通过贪心最小化候选子集与全量数据签名分布间的 Sliced Wasserstein 距离来选样。
AI.relevance_reason: 其以分布匹配为准则的贪心子集选择，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据/帧的筛选与 LOOK 预算分配提供思路，但研究对象是时间序列训练集选取，与 latent 推理状态无直接关系，需核查是否可迁移到证据选择。
